svg.title: Sound Creations Ltd Company Profile 2026 - Page 15

text.tspan: A high-energy club needs even coverage, high output, deep low-end and clarity that
holds up at high levels. We designed and installed a complete dB Technologies
system, positioning INGENIA 2, INGENIA 3 and OPERA 12 loudspeakers for
consistent coverage across the venue, with SUB DVA S30N and SUB 918 subwoofers
for the deep, powerful bass club music demands. Powerful sound. Precise coverage.
dB Technologies SUB DVA S30N subwoofers
